verified_facts.text: Le Bristol Paris is at 112 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honore in Paris.
verified_facts.excerpt: At 112 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré in the heart of the City of Light, Le Bristol Paris is a symbol of Parisian chic

verified_facts.text: Le Bristol Paris's restaurants are led by Chef Arnaud Faye, Meilleur Ouvrier de France.
verified_facts.excerpt: Le Bristol Paris's restaurants are a beacon of culinary excellence, spearheaded by Chef Arnaud Faye, Meilleur Ouvrier de France.

verified_facts.text: The spa is Spa Le Bristol by La Mer.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the moment you step into Spa Le Bristol by La Mer you relinquish the cares of the world

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an indoor rooftop swimming pool with views over Montmartre and the Eiffel Tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: A stunning indoor rooftop swimming pool with views over Montmartre and the Eiffel Tower completes this remarkable wellness offering in Paris.

verified_facts.text: The nautical-themed indoor pool was created by the same designer that did the Onassis yacht and is heated in all seasons.
verified_facts.excerpt: The nautical-themed indoor pool, created by the same designer that did the Onassis' yacht, is heated in all seasons

verified_facts.text: Le Bristol is named after Bishop Frederick Hervey, 4th Earl of Bristol, an eighteenth-century traveller.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named after Bishop Frederick Hervey, 4th Earl of Bristol, an eighteenth-century traveller famed for his love of comfort and the high standards he demanded

verified_facts.text: During World War II, the property served as the home of the American Embassy.
verified_facts.excerpt: During World War II, the property served as the home of the American Embassy

verified_facts.text: Famous guests have included Charlie Chaplin and Rita Hayworth.
verified_facts.excerpt: Famous guests over the years have included Charlie Chaplin and Rita Hayworth

verified_facts.text: Each room is unique in decoration and colour.
verified_facts.excerpt: each one unique in decoration and colour

verified_facts.text: Room decor is traditional, enhanced with original paintings and antique furniture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Decor is traditional and enhanced with original paintings and antique furniture.

verified_facts.text: Le Jardin Francais is the hotel's courtyard garden, with a fountain.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's resident Burmese cat, Socrate, wears a bespoke Goyard collar.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's kitchens include a chocolatier, a pasta-making kitchen, a patisserie and a bakery where wheat is milled fresh each day.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s a chocolatier, a pasta-making kitchen, a patisserie and even a bakery, where wheat is milled fresh each day

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers guests electric bicycles to ride.
